content:
Ashwin: Heads-up, saw an OOM cascade on prod-serving today during the 80B long-context A/B rollout.
Maria: saw perf-bot alert — can you paste the trace?
perf-bot: alert: gpu-mem-frag spike @1934567888, task batch=24, model=redwood-80b-v2, kernel=fast-attn-v3
Ashwin: logging snip: 
```
GPU0: free=5.2GB total=40GB
alloc failed for workspace 6.8GB
blockmgr: no reclaimable blocks (hot_count=0, frag=74%)
KV cache entries=1200 hit_rate=0.72
```
Kevin: interesting — kernel fast-attn-v3 ups workspace to avoid compaction, but with paged blocks it forces full alloc. Might be kernel selection fallback choice interacting w/ block reuse policy.
Dana: what were batching heuristics? any spike in batch size distribution?
Ashwin: traffic had more 2-3k token prompts, batching heuristics bumped to batch=24 for latency SLO; that increased per-request kv/attn workspace.
Maria: hypothesis: when kernel chooses continuous-kv path it avoids streaming kernels and requests contig workspace ~6-8GB; blockmgr fragmentation prevents satisfying and we OOM instead of evicting because eviction policy requires hot_count< threshold.
Kevin: can repro locally with synthetic seq lengths. Experiment notes: reduce batch cap or prefer streaming-kernel below threshold.
Ashwin: quick mitigation rolled: set kernel_selector.prefer_streaming=0.6 for this model, and lowered max_batch=16 for recent traffic.
perf-bot: deploy note: canary rollout for config change at 1934567920 -> success, mem-stable on canary 10/10 min
Maria: follow-up items: 1) add telemetry to record chosen kernel + requested_workspace per request; 2) make blockmgr compaction cost model account for imminent large continuous allocs; 3) evaluate eager prefix-evict when workspace request > 50% of free mem.
Dana: I'll file a short RFC for blockmgr compaction heuristics and include simple cost function: compaction_cost ~= blocked_bytes * compaction_multiplier - reclaimable_hot_bytes * benefit_factor
Kevin: also add a lightweight probe in kernel selection to ask blockmgr if allocation feasible before choosing kernel; fallback to streaming if not.
Ashwin: thanks — will track experiments in perf board. For now can we keep prefer_streaming change for 24h and monitor? :thumbsup:
Maria: ack. pushing dashboards: mem-frag, kernel-choice, requested_workspace, evictions.
